description_en: Queries the information about all clients that subscribe to a property. When a dynamic configuration client starts, it establishes a persistent connection with the server and reports its associated property information. You can use this persistent connection to query the information about all clients that subscribe to the property
description_zh: 查询一个属性所有订阅的客户端信息。动态配置客户端在启动的时候，会与服务端建立长连接，并告知动态配置服务端自身关联的属性信息，通过此长连接可以查询到所有订阅属性的客户端信息
name: QueryMsConfigClients

parameters.help_en: The auto-increment ID of the property. You can obtain the ID by querying the property
parameters.help_zh: 属性自增长 ID，通过查询属性方式获取 ID
parameters.name: attribute_id

parameters.help_zh: 系统字段：环境实例 ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size
